title: Tiered discount in the cart summary
goal: Add tiered discounts to shop.cart.summary using a new shop.pricing.discount_rate, with cent rounding.
acceptance_criteria: pricing.discount_rate(eligible) returns Decimal('0.15') for eligible >= 250, Decimal('0.10') for eligible >= 100, otherwise Decimal('0')
eligible is the subtotal of items whose kind is not 'gift_card' (items without a kind are eligible); gift cards never earn or receive a discount
the discount is eligible * rate rounded to cents with ROUND_HALF_UP
tax is TAX_RATE of (subtotal - discount), rounded to cents with ROUND_HALF_UP
cart.summary returns a dict with keys subtotal, discount, tax, total, all Decimals with exactly two decimals; total = subtotal - discount + tax
an empty cart gives all zeros (0.00)
